title: Workspace ONE to Intune — Windows Device Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Windows estate unenroll/re-enroll from Workspace ONE to Intune with profile/compliance parity and ringed cutover; live-device risk).
hook: Move Windows devices from Workspace ONE to Intune — re-enrolled, compliant, and unbroken
problem: Migrating Windows endpoints off Workspace ONE means cleanly removing the old management, enrolling into Intune, and landing the same configuration, compliance, and security — without users losing access or a device ending up managed by neither (or both). This solution is the repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune Windows device migration: prepare identity and enrollment, achieve profile/compliance parity, unenroll and re-enroll in controlled rings, and validate each device before moving on.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Windows migration model, unenroll-from-Workspace-ONE / enroll-to-Intune flow (Entra join + automatic enrollment), profile and compliance parity, Conditional Access continuity, and the ringed cutover.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Windows automatic enrollment, Workspace ONE admin access, the Windows baseline/parity target, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: confirm identity/enrollment, build parity configuration in Intune, unenroll from Workspace ONE and enroll to Intune by ring, validate configuration/compliance/access per device, then pilot, validate, and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — Windows migration-readiness discovery, per-device enrollment/parity validation, a migration status and compliance report, safe remediation of dual/failed enrollment, and a migration-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune Windows device migration — prepare identity and enrollment, achieve profile/compliance parity, unenroll and re-enroll in controlled rings, and validate each device. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
